paths.name: Path of Savagery
paths.description: A mastery path focused on lingering effects and weakening foes

ability.name: Rend Asunder
ability.description: Increases Rend's duration by an additional 6 seconds.

ability.name: Thunderous Blow
ability.note: Requires Gift of Savagery or Brutality
ability.description: A particularly nasty blow that inflicts 291 damage to your target and decreases their Wounds by 150 for the next 20 seconds.

ability.name: Exhaustive Strikes
ability.description: Any time you critically hit an enemy while Mutated, they will lose 40 Action Points over the next 3 seconds.

ability.name: Cutting Claw
ability.description: Undefendable claw attack that deals 291 damage and reduces targets armor by 1600 for 10 seconds.

ability.name: Deadly Clutch
ability.description: Tainted Claw will now reduce all healing used on the victim by 50%. Additionally, you will be healed for 50% of the heals actually received by the target.

ability.name: Draining Swipe
ability.description: You quickly rake your target twice, dealing 145 damage with each hit and applying full stacks of Rend to your target. The victim will regain action points 50% more slowly for 10 seconds.

ability.name: Lashing Power
ability.description: For 20 seconds, each time you are hit, there is a 33% chance that the same amount of damage will be done to an enemy within 40 feet, and you will be healed for that amount.

coreAbilities.name: Rend
coreAbilities.note: Requires Gift of Savagery or Brutality
coreAbilities.description: You tear into your target, dealing 145 damage immediately and an additional 264 damage over 9 seconds. The damage over time will stack with itself up to three times.

coreAbilities.name: Corruption
coreAbilities.description: Corruption spreads to your target, reducing their toughness by 150 for 20 seconds and inflicting 178 damage.

coreAbilities.name: Touch of Rot
coreAbilities.note: Requires Gift of Monstrosity or Savagery
coreAbilities.description: Spreads an agonizing rot to your opponent for 15 seconds, inflicting 352 Corporeal damage whenever they use a melee ability.

coreAbilities.name: Tainted Claw
coreAbilities.description: You rake the enemy with your tainted claw, dealing 216 damage and applying an Ailment that reduces incoming healing by 25% for 5 seconds, or 10 seconds if the target is already Ailing.

coreAbilities.name: Touch of Instability
coreAbilities.note: Requires Gift of Savagery or Brutality
coreAbilities.description: Target loses control over their magic, and for 10 seconds will inflict 390 Corporeal damage to themselves whenever they use magic.

paths.name: Path of Brutality
paths.description: A mastery path focused on inflicting heavy damage to a single opponent

ability.name: Deeply Impaled
ability.description: Any time you Impale an enemy, they will become 10% more susceptible to being critically hit for 15 seconds.

ability.name: Mutated Aggressor
ability.description:
Chaotic energy surges through you, increasing all the damage you inflict by 25% for 10 seconds.
Does not affect damage procs.

ability.name: Growing Instability
ability.description: The power of Chaos begins to take control of your body, causing all of your critical hits to deal an additional 50% bonus damage.

ability.name: Guillotine
ability.description:
Requires target to be below 50% health
A powerful blow inflicting 463 damage and will almost always deal critical damage to a weakened target. If this ability lands a killing blow, Guillotine and your stances will have their cooldowns reset.

ability.name: Unstable Convulsions
ability.description: Convulsive Slashing now gains a 50% chance to remove an Enchantment from the victim each time that it hits them.  Each time an Enchantment is successfully removed, they will suffer 214 damage .

ability.name: Gut Ripper
ability.description: A savage attack that guts your opponent, dealing 328 damage. Your next two, consequently-cast, damaging abilities within 5 seconds will automatically critical hit.

ability.name: Forked Aggression
ability.description: For 20 seconds, all damage dealt to you is mirrored back to the attacker with a 50% boost.

coreAbilities.name: Flail
coreAbilities.description: Swipes opponent for 183 damage. If Mutated, will hit an additional time for 145 damage.

coreAbilities.name: Debilitate
coreAbilities.description: A deliberate attack that inflicts 253 damage and Cripples your target, reducing their movement speed by 40% for 5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Impale
coreAbilities.description: Stabs into your opponents vital areas for 291 damage. If behind your target, ignores all of the victim's armor.

coreAbilities.name: Convulsive Slashing
coreAbilities.description: You continually slice at an enemy for up to 3 seconds, striking them up to 6 times and dealing 184 damage per hit.  This effect will end if you break your concentration or run out of action points.

coreAbilities.name: Pulverize
coreAbilities.note: Requires Gift of Brutality or Monstrosity
coreAbilities.description: Inflicts 328 damage and lowers your targets ability to parry by 10% and their ability to block by 10% for 10 seconds.

paths.name: Path of Monstrosity
paths.description: A mastery path focused on fightihg multiple opponents at once

ability.name: Widespread Demolition
ability.description: Increased Demolition's radius to 30 feet. If the target is Ailing, Demolition will deal an additional 264 damage over 3 seconds.

ability.name: Wave of Mutilation
ability.note: Requires Gift of Monstrosity or Savagery
ability.description: A wave of horror spreads forth from you, dealing 770 damage over 21 seconds to all enemies within 25 feet and reducing their Weapon Skill by 100 and Initiative by 100.

ability.name: Insane Whispers
ability.description: Mouth of Tzeentch will now disorient your enemies for 5 seconds, causing all of their abilities to take 50% longer to build up.

ability.name: Concussive Jolt
ability.description: A great wave of concussive force knocks down all targets 25 feet in front of you for 2 seconds, inflicting 150 damage.

ability.name: Crushing Blows
ability.description: While you are using the Gift Of Monstrosity, all of your hits have a 10% chance to remove 100 points of Morale from the enemy.

ability.name: Wrecking Ball
ability.description: Spinning in a circle with your club arm extended, you aimlessly deal 188 damage every second to all targets within 30 feet in front of you for up to 3 seconds.  This effect will end if you break your concentration or run out of action points.

ability.name: Energy Ripple
ability.description: A large burst of power courses through you, dealing 1800 damage to all targets within 25 feet, knocking down all targets around you for 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Demolition
coreAbilities.description: A widespread attack that inflicts 188 damage to all targets up to 25 feet in front of you.

coreAbilities.name: Mouth of Tzeentch
coreAbilities.note: Requires Gift of Monstrosity or Savagery
coreAbilities.description: Tzeentch's dark words pour from your mouth, interrupting any spells being cast 40 feet in front of you, and inflicting 183 damage to all in range.

coreAbilities.name: Ferocious Assault
coreAbilities.note: Requires Gift of Brutality or Monstrosity
coreAbilities.description: Chaotic winds and daemonic fury combine to increase your Strength and Toughness by 250 for 20 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Wave of Terror
coreAbilities.note: Requires Gift of Monstrosity or Savagery
coreAbilities.description: Wildly lashes out at all targets directly in front of you up to 25 feet away, dealing 258 damage and reducing their Morale gain by 50% for 5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Mutated Energy
coreAbilities.description: Disrupted Magic is twisted back into the caster, inflicting 328 damage and knocking them down for 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Bypass Defenses
coreAbilities.description: You bolster yourself for 10 seconds, allowing you to bypass the defenses of an enemy keep's postern door, porting you inside.

coreAbilities.name: Siege Wrecker
coreAbilities.description: You sabotage a siege ram, causing the ram to deal 98% of the original damage for the next 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Faultfinder
coreAbilities.description: Increases friendly ram damage by 2% for the next 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Flee
coreAbilities.description: You run away from the battle in a mad panic, increasing your run speed by 30% for 10 seconds.  You immediately lose all of your action points, any career mechanic points, and your Morale will begin to drop, and you will not begin to regain action points until 10 seconds have passed.

coreAbilities.name: Throw Axe
coreAbilities.description: Throwing axe that will deal 82 damage to your prey.

coreAbilities.name: Gift of Savagery
coreAbilities.description:
You are imbued with the Gift of Savagery, warping and twisting the flesh of your arm into a savage claw.

While mutated, your attacks have a 25% chance to deal an additional 505 damage over 5 seconds, and reduce the victim's autoattack speed by 33%.

coreAbilities.name: Gift of Release
coreAbilities.description: Releases your current mutation.

coreAbilities.name: Charge!
coreAbilities.description: You charge into the thick of battle, increasing your run speed by 50% for 7 seconds.  If you use any abilities, this effect will immediately end.

coreAbilities.name: Gift of Brutality
coreAbilities.description:
You are imbued with the Gift of Brutality, warping and twisting the flesh of your arm into a brutal blade.

While mutated, your attacks have a 25% chance to fill you with power for 5 seconds, making it almost certain that your offhand weapon will swing on every attack and increasing your offhand damage by 25%.

coreAbilities.name: Wave of Horror
coreAbilities.description: All enemies within 25 feet are detaunted, making them hate you less and reducing the damage they deal against you to 50% for 5 seconds.  During this time, all of your attacks will cause enemies to hate you 25% less than normal. You will also deal 50% damage to them until the effect is broken. If you attack anyone you have detaunted, the effect will immediately end.

coreAbilities.name: Gift of Monstrosity
coreAbilities.description:
You are imbued with the Gift of Monstrosity, warping and twisting the flesh of your arm into a vicious club.

While mutated, your attacks have a 25% chance to empower you for 5 seconds, gradually restoring 1032 health, letting you shrug off 20% of your enemy's armor penetration, and increasing the healing you receive by 10%.

coreAbilities.name: Sever Nerve
coreAbilities.description: A directed strike that inflicts 1200 damage to your target.

coreAbilities.name: Warped Flesh
coreAbilities.description:
Any time you are attacked, there is a 25% chance that you will absorb up to 375 damage.
This effect will not trigger more than once every 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Mutating Release
coreAbilities.description: Your bones and muscles twist and contort to free you from any root or snaring effects. You will also be immune from all snares and roots for the next 10 seconds

coreAbilities.name: Force of Will
coreAbilities.description: You stare down your opponent, draining 200 of their Action Points into yourself, and reducing their Strength by 160 for 30 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Jagged Edge
coreAbilities.description: Any time you critically hit an enemy they will begin to bleed, suffering additional 513 Corporeal damage over 9 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Subvert Strength
coreAbilities.description: Any time you critically hit an enemy, you will regain 40 Action Points. Tactic can not trigger more than once every 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Death Grip
coreAbilities.description: Deals 141 damage to your target and disarms them for 4 seconds, making them unable to use melee or ranged weapons.

coreAbilities.name: Brute Force
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Strength by 160.

coreAbilities.name: Confusing Movements
coreAbilities.description: Concentrating on your perceived movements, you will be able to Dodge and Parry all attacks against you for 7 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Tzeentch's Warding
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Elemental resistance by 252.

coreAbilities.name: Relentless Assault
coreAbilities.description: A prolonged fervor that grants 10 Action Points a second to everyone in your group within 100 feet of you for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Brush Off
coreAbilities.description: Increases your chance to Disrupt enemy magic by 10%. Each time you disrupt an ability, you will remove one Hex, Curse or Ailment from yourself. This cannot happen more than once every 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Backlash
coreAbilities.description: Any time you are attacked, there is a 25% chance that you will lash out for 370 Elemental damage over 5 seconds to anyone who hits you.

coreAbilities.name: Overpowering Blow
coreAbilities.description: You strike your opponent with surprising force, dealing 1200 damage and knocking them down for 4 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Flanking
coreAbilities.description:
All of your attacks deal 15% more damage when you strike an enemy from the sides or rear.
Does not affect damage procs.

coreAbilities.name: Close Combat
coreAbilities.description: Any time you strike an enemy in melee with a direct attack, you will receive 25% less damage from ranged and magical attacks for 2 seconds. This effect will not guard or detaunt abilities.

coreAbilities.name: Changer's Gift
coreAbilities.description:
You gain additional stats based on the Gift you are currently imbued with:
  Gift of Savagery: +80 Strength and Initiative
  Gift of Brutality: +80 Strength and Weapon Skill
  Gift of Monstrosity: +80 Toughness and Initiative.

These bonuses are increased to 120 for 3 secondswhenever you swap Gift.

coreAbilities.name: Flames of Fate
coreAbilities.description: Your target is engulfed in the chaotic flames of fate, dealing 900 damage and rooting them in place for 5 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Riposte
coreAbilities.description: Each time you parry an enemy's attack, you will strike them back for 253 damage which they can not prevent.

coreAbilities.name: Lasting Mutation
coreAbilities.description: Your effects from your Gifts will last an additional 2 seconds and will linger when changing to a different Gift.

coreAbilities.name: Great Fang
coreAbilities.description: A mighty swing attack that inflicts 1200 damage to all targets 40 feet in front of you.

coreAbilities.name: Feeding On Fear
coreAbilities.description: Any time you critically hit an enemy, your chance to critically hit will be increased by 20% for 5 seconds, but you will also become 10% more susceptible to being critically hit.

coreAbilities.name: Unending Horror
coreAbilities.description: Increases Wave of Horror's duration to 15 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Tzeentch's Reversal
coreAbilities.description: Melee attack that deals 1200 damage and returns all of that damage as health to all group members within 100ft.

coreAbilities.name: Mutating Corruption
coreAbilities.description:
Corruption now applies the following effects based on your current mutation:
  Savagery: The target takes 10% more damage from damage over time abilities for the duration of Corruption.
  Brutality: Increase your Weapon Skill by 150 for 10 seconds.
  Monstrosity: All enemies within 25 feet have their Toughness reduced by 100 for 20 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Piercing Bite
coreAbilities.description: All of your abilities which require a Mutation will now have armor penetration increased by 15% .

coreAbilities.name: Terrible Embrace
coreAbilities.description: Extends a tendril of energy to pull an opposing player towards you. Monster targets will be dragged to the ground.

coreAbilities.name: Frenzied Slaughter
coreAbilities.description: All of your abilities will cost 25% fewer action points, cool down 50% faster, and deal 20% more damage for 7 seconds.
